reason_for_stop: The lead reports a sealed enclosure and a user-stated maximum of 75-85 C, with air versus chip-surface interpretation still unresolved. X5R selection is rejected pending that clarification and a measured or modeled MLCC temperature envelope. Work stopped without further optimization or BOM edits.
current_priority: X7R / 125 C candidates, effective capacitance and hotspot qualification

current_master_observation.note: 246 XML references observed after lead regeneration. Historical area calculation below deliberately remains attached to the earlier 243-envelope snapshot. It is not an updated current-board total.

factor_caveat: Every screen uses typical 25 C data multiplied by 0.80 initial tolerance, 0.85 temperature retention, 0.90 illustrative aging and 0.90 illustrative model margin. The latter factors are assumptions, not a vendor combined-condition guaranteed minimum. No factor makes an 85 C maximum part safe at an 85 C enclosure ambient.

thermal_gate.temperature_definition: Samsung specification section 3-1 uses MLCC surface temperature including self-heating, not ambient.
thermal_gate.derating_graph_review: Exact CL05A226MP6NUNC specification PDF page 18 was visually inspected. Its derated-MLCC example reduces allowed operating voltage near the maximum MLCC temperature. This does not provide temperature headroom. Exact part applicable derating must be checked.
missing_requirements: Whether reported 75-85 C is enclosure air, ambient outside the enclosure or device surface
Maximum local MLCC surface temperature including PCB conduction and ripple self-heating
Thermal margin, lifetime and voltage/temperature derating policy
Worst-case capacitance under simultaneous DC bias, AC ripple, temperature, aging and production spread

TI_scope.tiny_reference: TI TPS62864 table 9-6 lists GRM155R60J226ME11, 22 uF / 6.3 V X5R 0402. Exact current Murata PDF fetch returned 404; numeric Murata bias data were not recovered. Samsung curves are for their exact MPNs only and are not interchangeable evidence.
TI_scope.five_22uF_bank: 110 uF nominal lies between listed 66 uF and 150 uF examples, but the exact 110 uF / candidate-inductor combination is not one of the table marked combinations. Startup, loop stability and transients remain open.
TI_scope.voltage_scope: 1.675 V is a converter-capability stress point only, not an authorized K230 voltage. 3.465 V is an illustrative +5% check, not an established rail tolerance.

historical_single_coherent_hypothesis.description: Two 47 uF / 10 V 0805 inputs per TPS62864, one per TPS6282xA, five 22 uF / 10 V 0402 outputs per CPU/KPU, three 22 uF 0402 memory decouplers, four 47 uF / 10 V 0805 outputs, and ten retained 4.7 uF X7R 0603 capacitors. Memory decoupler effective-capacitance and PI requirements are not established.

area_groups.group: Ten local 4.7 uF positions, retained X7R

historical_single_coherent_hypothesis.area_method: Maximum manufacturer family reflow lands union body plus assumed 0.25 mm each side, rounded. 0402 +/-0.2 mm row maximum is 1.72 x 0.74 mm; 0805 +/-0.2 mm row maximum is 2.95 x 1.45 mm. These are planning assumptions, not universal courtyard minima or released footprints.
